name: WordPress version disclosed via /readme.html
description: WordPress ships a /readme.html file containing the running version. Removing it forces attackers to fingerprint by harder paths.
remediation: Delete /readme.html on every deployment, or block it at the web server.

name: Drupal CHANGELOG.txt exposed
description: Drupal ships a CHANGELOG.txt that often discloses the current version. Combined with a known-vulnerable version, attackers go straight to the matching exploit.
remediation: Block /CHANGELOG.txt on Drupal sites at the web server.

name: Spring Boot Actuator /actuator/env exposed
description: Spring Boot Actuator's /actuator/env endpoint discloses every environment variable AND application property — including database URLs, API keys, and secrets.
remediation: Restrict /actuator to internal networks only, OR set `management.endpoints.web.exposure.include=health,info` to expose only safe endpoints.

name: Spring Boot Actuator /actuator/heapdump exposed
description: Public /actuator/heapdump downloads a JVM heap snapshot — contains in-memory passwords, JWT keys, session tokens.
remediation: Disable the heapdump endpoint in production (`management.endpoint.heapdump.enabled=false`).

name: PHP info() page exposed
description: phpinfo() dumps PHP version, loaded modules, environment variables, file paths, build flags. Source for many CVE lookups.
remediation: Delete or block all phpinfo() pages from production deployments.

name: Swagger UI / OpenAPI Explorer publicly accessible
description: Swagger UI exposes the full API contract — every endpoint, parameter, schema. Useful for legitimate users but also a recon goldmine for attackers.
remediation: If the API is internal, gate Swagger UI behind auth. Public APIs should still strip server/host information from the spec.

name: Prometheus /metrics endpoint public
description: Prometheus metrics often leak request counts, error rates, JVM internals, and sometimes labels containing user IDs / IP addresses.
remediation: Bind /metrics to localhost or restrict by IP allow-list.

name: Git directory exposed (.git/HEAD reachable)
description: Apache configs occasionally serve .git/* — attackers can reconstruct the entire source tree using git-dumper.
remediation: Block /.git/* at the web server. Don't deploy with .git in the docroot.

name: WordPress debug.log exposed
description: WordPress writes WP_DEBUG output to wp-content/debug.log — if served, leaks query errors, stack traces, plugin internals.
remediation: Disable WP_DEBUG_LOG, or set it to a path outside the docroot.

name: Spring Boot Actuator index reachable
description: Actuator landing page reveals which sub-endpoints are exposed. Use it as a guide to /env, /heapdump, /trace, /loggers — each of which has its own severity.
